name: Offline Ingestion, Chunking & ChromaDB Persistence
prompt: Implement the /api/v1/documents/ingest endpoint using local ChromaDB and Ollama. Chunk the document into overlapping units, generate dense vectors locally without third-party API calls, and persist chunks with tenant and classification metadata.

verification.criteria: Ingestion returns HTTP 201 with status 'ingested' and chunks_created >= 1
